name: supply-wagon
_doc: 보급 마차 (supply wagon): WWI two-wheel limber cart, two draught horses (cavalry horse model, bridle + collar, no saddle), canvas-covered ammo crates, seated driver (shared infantry body, field-grey tunic, Feldkappe with team band). Team colour: Feldkappe band, canvas band and pennant. 5 directions + mirror like cavalry; frame 256x224, anchor = ground under the assembly centre.
